# Data Tooly

> Free micro-tools for developers, analysts & researchers. Free, no-signup, browser-based query & search builders for public data sources. Each tool gives instant value in the browser and links to a production Apify actor for full structured extraction at scale.

Built and maintained by Omar Eldeeb (Apify Store handle: constructive_calm), who publishes 25 public production data actors.

## Tools

- [Hiring & Sales Signals](https://datatooly.xyz/company-hiring-signals/): See what any company is hiring for and what it signals. Free in-browser tool reads live Greenhouse roles and flags hiring intent. No login. Try it now.
- [Patents & IP](https://datatooly.xyz/google-patents-search-builder/): Search Google Patents by company, inventor, or keyword the structured way. Free query builder + sample preview, plus a path to bulk CSV/JSON export. Try it.
- [Social & Community](https://datatooly.xyz/reddit-search-builder/): Build a Reddit keyword/subreddit search query free in your browser, preview the output, then export posts + comments to CSV/JSON. No API key, no login.
- [Dev & Community](https://datatooly.xyz/hacker-news-search/): Search Hacker News by keyword live — real stories, points, comments, author, date. Free browser tool on the public HN Algolia API, no key. Filters + scale upsell.
- [App Intelligence](https://datatooly.xyz/app-store-top-charts/): See the App Store top charts live, free, in any country. Real-time Top Free, Top Paid & Top Grossing apps straight from Apple's official iTunes RSS feed.
- [Health & Pharma](https://datatooly.xyz/clinical-trials-search/): Search ClinicalTrials.gov live by condition, drug, or phase. Free browser tool hits the official v2 REST API (no key, CORS-open) and shows real NCT studies.
- [E-commerce Intelligence](https://datatooly.xyz/shopify-store-products/): Free live tool: enter a Shopify domain and read its public /products.json in your browser — real titles, vendors, variants, prices, stock. No app, no key.
- [News & Crypto](https://datatooly.xyz/crypto-news-search/): Free Cointelegraph scraper query builder. Configure keyword, language, and article count, preview the JSON output shape, then run it live on the Apify actor.
- [Real Estate](https://datatooly.xyz/egypt-real-estate-search/): Build a query for Egypt property listings data from Aqarmap, Dubizzle &amp; Property Finder, preview the output shape, then run it on Apify to export CSV/JSON.
- [Ads Intelligence](https://datatooly.xyz/facebook-ad-library-search/): Build a ready-to-run Facebook Ad Library scraper query — keyword, country, active status — and preview the export shape, then run it live on Apify.
- [Sports Analytics](https://datatooly.xyz/fpl-intelligence-tool/): Build a ready-to-run Fantasy Premier League API query for gameweek picks and manager dashboards, preview the output shape, then run it live on Apify.
- [Automotive](https://datatooly.xyz/gulf-used-car-search/): Build a query for Dubai used car listings data across DubiCars and Dubizzle, preview the export shape, then run it live. Make, model, price, mileage in AED.
- [Lead Generation](https://datatooly.xyz/linkedin-profile-lookup/): Free query builder for a LinkedIn profile scraper: paste profile URLs, preview the JSON output shape, then run it on Apify — no cookies or login.
- [AI & SEO](https://datatooly.xyz/llm-visibility-monitor-tool/): Build a ready-to-run query to track brand mentions in ChatGPT and 4 other AI engines. Preview the output shape, then run it live on Apify. Free to start.
- [Crypto & DeFi](https://datatooly.xyz/mev-pair-scanner-tool/): Build a ready-to-run query for DEX sandwich attack MEV data — preview the per-pair output shape (sandwich rate, MEV fee ratio, risk level), then run it live.
- [Health & Pharma](https://datatooly.xyz/peptide-market-intel-tool/): Build a ready-to-run query for peptide market research data: track GLP-1, BPC-157 and 30+ compounds across YouTube, Amazon and optional Reddit with sentiment.
- [SaaS & SEO](https://datatooly.xyz/saas-pricing-tracker-tool/): Build a ready-to-run query to track competitor SaaS pricing and plan changes. Preview the structured output shape, then run it live on Apify. Free to start.
- [Real Estate](https://datatooly.xyz/saudi-real-estate-search/): Build a query for Saudi Arabia property data across Bayut.sa, Wasalt, Aqar.fm and PropertyFinder.sa, preview the output shape, then run it live to export listings.
- [Finance & Filings](https://datatooly.xyz/sec-edgar-search/): Build a ready-to-run SEC EDGAR API query for filings, XBRL financials & insider trades by ticker, preview the output shape, then run it live on the actor.
- [Social & Community](https://datatooly.xyz/telegram-channel-search/): Build a ready-to-run config to scrape Telegram channel posts, views, and reactions. Preview the output shape, then run it live on the Apify actor.
- [Social & Community](https://datatooly.xyz/threads-profile-search/): Free Threads scraper query builder. Configure profile, posts & hashtag scrapes, preview the output shape, then run live on Apify. No login needed.
- [Ads Intelligence](https://datatooly.xyz/tiktok-ad-library-search/): Build a TikTok Ad Library query by keyword or advertiser, check if your market is in the 33 EU/DSA regions, preview the output, then run it live.
- [Sports Analytics](https://datatooly.xyz/understat-football-stats/): Build a ready-to-run query for Understat xG data — players, teams, shots across 6 leagues since 2014/15 — preview the output shape, then run it live.
- [Jobs & Visas](https://datatooly.xyz/visa-sponsor-finder/): Free H-1B visa sponsor lookup query builder. Set a role + city, preview the output shape, then run it live on real DOL LCA & PERM sponsor data.
- [Jobs & Visas](https://datatooly.xyz/salary-benchmark-lookup/): Benchmark what a role pays using public DOL H-1B/PERM wage disclosure data — percentiles by city, state, or employer, or individual records. Free to start.
